name: TAN

name: TIME
description: Time part of a time/datetime expression.

description: Difference between two time/datetime values as a TIME.

description: Difference dt2 - dt1 expressed in the given unit.

description: Formats a time value as a string using % specifiers.

description: Converts a time value to a number of seconds.

description: Encodes a string as base64.

description: Parses a string into a DATE using a format model.

name: TO_DAYS
description: Day number of a date counted from year 0.

name: TO_JSON
description: Converts a value, row, table column, or PSQL array/record to JSON.

name: TO_NUMBER
description: Converts a string to a number, optionally using a format model.

name: TO_QUERY
description: PSQL: converts a dynamic SQL string into a QUERY value.

name: TO_SECONDS
description: Seconds since year 0 for a date/datetime.

name: TO_TIMESTAMP
description: Parses a string into a TIMESTAMP using a format model.

name: TRIM
description: Removes leading and/or trailing characters (spaces by default).

name: TRUNC
description: Truncates a number to d decimals, or a date to the given unit.

name: TRUNCATE
description: Truncates a number to d decimal places.

name: UCASE

name: UNHEX

name: UNIX_TIMESTAMP
